name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
description: Direct income support of Rs 6000 per year to small and marginal farmers, paid in three equal installments of Rs 2000 every four months directly to bank accounts.
eligibility: All landholding farmer families with cultivable land
Small and marginal farmers with less than 2 hectares land
Must have Aadhaar card and bank account linked
benefits: Rs 6,000 per year direct bank transfer
Paid in 3 installments of Rs 2,000 each
howToApply: Visit pmkisan.gov.in or nearest Common Service Centre
Register with your Aadhaar and land details

name: PM Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
description: Comprehensive crop insurance scheme providing financial support to farmers suffering crop loss or damage due to unforeseen events like natural calamities, pests and diseases.
eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas
Farmers with crop loans (loanee farmers - compulsory)
Non-loanee farmers can voluntarily enroll
Tenant and sharecropper farmers also eligible
benefits: Premium as low as 1.5% for Rabi, 2% for Kharif
Coverage for prevented sowing, mid-season adversity, post-harvest losses
Coverage up to sum insured value of crop
howToApply: Enroll through nearest bank branch or CSC
Apply before cutoff date (notified by state)

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
description: Credit scheme providing farmers with timely and adequate credit for agricultural operations, post-harvest expenses, maintenance of farm assets and consumption requirements.
eligibility: Farmers engaged in crop cultivation
Allied activities like animal husbandry, fisheries
Tenant farmers, oral lessees, sharecroppers
Self Help Groups and Joint Liability Groups
benefits: Credit limit up to Rs 3 lakh at 4% interest (with subsidy)
No collateral up to Rs 1.60 lakh
Personal accident insurance cover of Rs 50,000
howToApply: Visit nearest bank (SBI, cooperative bank, RRB)
Bank verifies land and crop details
KCC issued within 2 weeks of approval

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
description: Provides soil health cards to farmers carrying crop-wise recommendations of nutrients and fertilizers required for individual farms to help improve productivity.
eligibility: All farmers across India
Cards issued once every 2 years
Available for all land holding sizes
benefits: Reduces input costs by avoiding over-fertilization
howToApply: Contact local Krishi Vigyan Kendra or agriculture department
Provide soil sample from your field
Soil is tested at government lab

name: PM Krishi Sinchai Yojana (PMKSY)
description: Aims to enhance water use efficiency and bring more area under irrigation with the motto 'Har Khet Ko Pani' and 'More Crop Per Drop'.
eligibility: Farmers in water-scarce regions
Small and marginal farmers get priority
Available across all states
benefits: Up to 55% subsidy for small farmers on drip irrigation

name: Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana (RKVY)
description: State-level scheme providing investment support for agriculture and allied sectors to achieve 4% growth in agriculture, encouraging states to increase public expenditure on agriculture.
eligibility: State governments apply on behalf of farmers
Farmers benefit through state agriculture programs
Focuses on districts with low agricultural productivity
benefits: Training and skill development for farmers
howToApply: State agriculture department applies to center
Check state agriculture department website for active schemes

name: eNAM (National Agriculture Market)
description: Online trading platform for agricultural commodities connecting mandis across India, enabling farmers to get better prices through transparent online bidding.
eligibility: Any farmer with registered produce
Available in all connected states and mandis
All major agricultural commodities covered
benefits: Better price discovery through online auction
Payment directly to bank account within 24 hours
No need to travel to distant mandis
howToApply: Register at enam.gov.in or nearest mandi
Register produce and upload quality details
Auction happens online, best price received

name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY)
description: Promotes organic farming through a cluster approach with adoption of organic villages by supporting farmers through incentives for traditional/indigenous practices.
eligibility: Farmers willing to convert to organic farming
Group of at least 50 farmers forming a cluster
Minimum 50 acres of contiguous land per cluster
benefits: Better market access and premium prices
requiredDocuments: Willingness certificate to practice organic farming
howToApply: Form a group with neighboring farmers

name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
description: Financing facility for post-harvest management infrastructure and community farming assets through interest subvention and credit guarantee support.
eligibility: Farmers, FPOs, PACS, Agri-entrepreneurs
Startups working in agriculture sector
Self Help Groups (SHGs)
benefits: Loans up to Rs 2 crore with 3% interest subvention
Credit guarantee for loans up to Rs 2 crore
For cold storage, warehouses, processing units
howToApply: Bank sanctions loan with AIF benefit

name: PM-AASHA (Pradhan Mantri Annadata Aay SanraksHan Abhiyan)
description: Comprehensive umbrella scheme to ensure remunerative prices to farmers for their produce. Includes Price Support Scheme (PSS), Price Deficiency Payment Scheme (PDPS), and Private Procurement Stockist Scheme (PPSS).
eligibility: Farmers growing oilseeds, pulses and copra
Registered farmers in notified areas
Available during harvest season when prices fall below MSP
benefits: Price deficiency directly paid to bank account
Up to 25% of production procured by states
No middlemen - direct payment to farmers
howToApply: Register with local procurement agency during harvest season
Sell produce at designated procurement centers

name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM)
description: Promotes mechanization at farm level with financial assistance for purchase of agricultural machinery and equipment to improve farm productivity and reduce drudgery.
eligibility: All categories of farmers
SC/ST and women farmers get higher subsidy
Preference to small and marginal farmers
benefits: SC/ST farmers get up to 50% subsidy
Custom Hiring Centre support for groups
howToApply: Select machinery and apply for subsidy
Buy from empanelled dealer after approval

name: National Food Security Mission (NFSM)
description: Increases production of rice, wheat, pulses, coarse cereals and nutri-cereals through area expansion and productivity enhancement in sustainable manner.
eligibility: Farmers in identified districts and blocks
Farmers growing rice, wheat, pulses, millets
Small and marginal farmers given priority
benefits: Training for farmers on best practices
howToApply: Seeds and inputs provided through CSCs and Agriculture Department

name: National Beekeeping & Honey Mission (NBHM)
description: Promotes scientific beekeeping for livelihood support and pollination services. Targets doubling of honey production and quadrupling honey exports.
eligibility: Farmers willing to take up beekeeping
Existing beekeepers
SHGs and FPOs
benefits: Financial assistance for bee colonies and boxes
Support for setting up honey testing labs

name: Crop Diversification Programme (CDP)
description: Encourages farmers to shift from traditional crops to diversified and high-value crops for better income. Specially focused in Punjab, Haryana and western UP.
eligibility: Farmers in paddy-wheat belt states
Mainly Punjab, Haryana, western Uttar Pradesh
benefits: Subsidy on seeds of alternative crops like maize, oilseeds, pulses

name: Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture (MIDH)
description: Holistic development of horticulture sector covering fruits, vegetables, flowers, aromatic and medicinal plants, mushrooms and spices.
eligibility: Farmers growing or planning to grow horticultural crops
All states and UTs covered
benefits: Subsidy on planting material and nurseries
